liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): The transition from Alabama Getaway to The Promised Land is highlighted [13]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewers call this performance possibly the best version of the song ever [13]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The disco-trippy performance of Shakedown Street brought a smile to the listener [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-26.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.89187.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 28 songs; 199 min; rated 3.95/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Joani Walker's audience recording feels present, unlike typical backstage-style tapes; Instruments sit back in the mix, but second set jamming is entertaining; Brent's organ is buried in the mix on the Dick's Picks version [8][12][15][18]
- **gd1979-12-26.144774.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 185 min [2]
- **gd1979-12-26.sbd.evans.gems.81323.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Solos burn with energy, though the recording feels slightly disjointed; Big River had slight static, fixed by crossfading channels [4][19]
- **gd1979-12-26.154873.s2.mtx.seamons.ht138.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 111 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- Jerry forgot words and Bobby missed cues, yet the performance remained magical [10]
- Healy and Don Pearson built a complex five-way stereo PA system [11]
- The audience showed quiet reverence during the performance of Brokedown Palace [17]
- Performance is considered far more entertaining than the December 28, 1979 show [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-26.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.89187.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90) [1]. Also: Joani Walker and Paul Scotton provided the original tapes for this source [1]
- **gd1979-12-26.144774.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (stand mounted, DFC, 35' from stage at the free throw circle)> Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [2]. Also: The Sony ECM-250 source patches small gaps in The Other One and UJB [2]
- **gd1979-12-26.sbd.evans.gems.81323.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: DAT(?) > TASCAM DA-20 (spdif out) -> Apogee Wide Eye spdif innterconnect -> Lynx Two Soundcard (spdif in) -> Wavelab 6.0 [4]. Also: Unknown audience recording covers Cold Rain and half of C.C. Rider [4]
- **gd1979-12-26.154873.s2.mtx.seamons.ht138.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro [5]. Also: Mason's first-generation safety tape was preferred for its immersive sound [5]
